description:
# Header Filter Plugin

## 📝 Summary

Adds a security plugin that filters sensitive HTTP headers before sending requests to MCP endpoints. Prevents leakage of cookies, auth tokens, and other sensitive data.

**Files Added:**
- `plugins/header_filter/header_filter_plugin.py` (264 lines)
- `plugins/header_filter/config.yaml` (39 lines)
- `plugins/header_filter/README.md` (181 lines)
- `tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/plugins/header_filter/test_header_filter_plugin.py` (414 lines)

---

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [x] Feature / Enhancement

---

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                     | Command         | Status |
|---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| Lint suite                | `make lint`     | x    |
| Unit tests                | `make test`     | x|
| Coverage ≥ 80%            | `make coverage` | x  |

---

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] Tests added/updated (14 test cases)
- [x] Documentation updated (README.md)
- [x] No secrets committed

---

## 📓 Notes

**Default Config:**
```yaml
filter_headers: ["Cookie", "Set-Cookie"]
mode: "permissive"
priority: 20
```

**Key Features:**
- Case-insensitive filtering
- Per-server configuration via conditions
- Passthrough exceptions for flexibility
- Works with Vault plugin (priority 10 < 20)

commits.message:
fix(plugins): fix frozen payload mutation, broken hooks, and field errors in header filter plugin

- Fix frozen PluginPayload mutation: use model_copy(update=...) instead of
  direct attribute assignment which raises ValidationError
- Remove resource_pre_fetch hook: ResourcePreFetchPayload has no headers field
- Remove prompt_prehook hook: PromptPrehookPayload has no headers or name field
- Fix agent_pre_invoke to use payload.agent_id instead of payload.name
- Use HttpHeaderPayload(root=...) keyword arg matching vault plugin convention
- Replace Set[str] import with builtin set[str] for Python 3.11+
- Add test __init__.py for consistency with other plugin test directories
- Fix README defaults to include X-Vault-Tokens (matches config.yaml)
- Rewrite tests: 25 tests (up from 14), 100% coverage, all passing
- Pylint 10.00/10, black/ruff/flake8 clean

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
